subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Akbar was the eldest son of Humayun and he ascended the throne of Delhi only at the age of fourteen years. Then Delhi was full of problems but he overcame all the problems with the help of Bairam Khan who was his guardian. He captured Panipath and Delhi defeating Hemu. He conquered Ajmer, Gualior, Jaunpur and kingdom after kingdom. He also conquered Malwa, Gujrat, Bengal, Kabul, Kashmir, Sind, Kandahar and Orissa. Thus he became more powerful. His son Salim killed his principal secretary Abul Fazl. This made him sad. This great warrior died in 1605.
